# Create Tacz

## A Create-driven warfare and expansion modpack
Create Tacz is a modpack built around industrial progression, automated weapons production, and large-scale expansion.

At its core, the pack combines Create, TaCZ, and advanced engineering into a progression path focused on building infrastructure, scaling production, and preparing for increasingly demanding stages of combat and exploration.

## Major renewal underway
This project is currently undergoing a major renewal.

The current version remains available, but the pack is being reworked into a more polished and better structured experience with a clearer long-term identity. The goal is to push Create Tacz further into industrial warfare, aeronautics, advanced resource progression, and eventually off-world expansion.

## Planned direction
The renewed direction of the pack is centered around:

- Create-based automation and logistics
- TaCZ combat progression and weapons manufacturing
- industrial and military engineering
- steampunk-inspired machinery and aeronautics
- stronger mid-to-late game resource progression
- planetary progression and long-term off-world content

## Design goals
The aim of this rebuild is not simply to add more content, but to improve the overall quality of the pack.

Current development priorities include:

- cleaner progression and better balance
- improved stability and performance
- stronger integration between combat, automation, and exploration
- better quest flow and overall guidance
- improved presentation, visuals, and pack identity

## Looking ahead
Create Tacz started as a fun idea and is now being rebuilt with a much more serious direction behind it.

The long-term vision is to create a modpack that feels larger in scale, more immersive in progression, and more rewarding to invest time into as it continues to evolve.

Thank you to everyone who has played, downloaded, or supported the project so far. More updates are planned as development continues.
